BUILD 11
- Every gun has its own sound now: small guns snap, SMGs rattle, rifles crack, shotguns boom.
- No shooting while sprinting.
- Scientists: twice as many at each place (and some at the tower and dish), they call the others over, sidestep while firing, and come looking where they last saw you.
- General Exchange at the outpost scrap exchange: sells anything you carry for a little scrap.
- MAIN MENU in the pause menu.
- Trees no longer block helicopters above their tops.
